profile.name: Hasnae Ahouzi
profile.title: Robotics & AI Engineer
profile.bio: 4th-year Robotics & AI Engineer at UEMF Fes (2027). I build intelligent systems — computer vision pipelines, autonomous robots, full-stack web & Android apps. Ready to bring your project to life.

journey.title: Engineering in Robotics & Cobotics
journey.description: 5th-year engineering student at EIDIA School. Specializing in computer vision, ROS2, autonomous systems, and AI.

projects.title: Trash Detector Robot
projects.subtitle: YOLOv8 Real-time Waste Detection
projects.description: Intelligent trash detection system trained on the TACO dataset, reduced and categorized into 5 waste classes. Supports real-time webcam detection for autonomous robot integration.

projects.title: ROS2 Café Service Robot
projects.subtitle: Autonomous Indoor Delivery Robot
projects.description: Full ROS2 Humble stack for an autonomous mobile robot designed for café/restaurant environments. Features Nav2 autonomous navigation, SLAM Toolbox for mapping, and Gazebo simulation.

projects.title: SerbAI Mobile App
projects.subtitle: Android Interface for Delivery Robot
projects.description: Android command & supervision interface for an autonomous line-following restaurant delivery robot. Features Auto/Manual/Stop modes, Bluetooth SPP control, 3 speed levels, and real-time event logging.

projects.title: SkinAId Web App
projects.subtitle: AI-Based Skin Disease Detection
projects.description: Web application using deep learning and image processing to detect and classify skin diseases from user-uploaded photos. Trained on Google Colab with Python and Jupyter.

projects.title: Hack AI Morocco
projects.subtitle: Event Platform — 4-Day AI Hackathon
projects.description: Dynamic web platform for "Hack AI Morocco", a 4-day hackathon bringing AI students across Morocco together for intensive challenges. Built with Astro, Tailwind CSS, and TypeScript.

projects.title: Laravel + React App
projects.subtitle: Full-Stack API Integration
projects.description: Full-stack application connecting a Laravel REST API backend with a React.js frontend. Implements CRUD operations, Blade templates, and demonstrates modern API consumption patterns.

projects.title: Free-Fall Detection System
projects.subtitle: Model-Based Design in Simulink
projects.description: Real-time free-fall detection logic in MATLAB/Simulink following Model-Based Design methodology (MIL/SIL testing) with accelerometer signal processing and threshold logic.

projects.title: FIR Filter on FPGA
projects.subtitle: VHDL Implementation on Cyclone V
projects.description: Digital FIR filter implemented in VHDL for Altera Cyclone V FPGA. Designed, synthesized, and verified with Quartus Prime and ModelSim simulation environments.

projects.title: Secure Locking System
projects.subtitle: PIC16F877A + RFID Embedded Design
projects.description: Smart security locking system using PIC16F877A with RFID authentication, keypad input, and LCD display. Programmed in MicroC and fully simulated in Proteus 8.
